winter_selection: maximum total consumption among complete January days
summer_selection: maximum total PV among complete June days
assumptions: 55 loads use cyclic H1-H20 demand and cyclic H1-H10 PV; repeated profiles are not 55 independent measurements.
All 55 simulated customers have PV and a battery; no PV capacity rescaling is performed.
350 kVA is a transparent change to the public 800 kVA feeder; it is not the authors' unavailable modified circuit.
Net active power equals gross demand minus PV plus AC battery charging minus AC discharging; Q uses gross demand at PF 0.95 and unity-PF inverters.
Community dispatch is a lossless pooled energy LP; no bilateral P2P allocation, market clearing prices, network constraints or paper-specific loss weight.
A second LP minimises battery throughput within 1e-7 EUR of the best bill, with fixed small index weights for tie handling; this is not a VUF-optimal dispatch.
Hourly averages from published processed Wh timestamps are used without a timezone shift, interpolation or manual H4 correction.
Complete means 60 finite nonnegative processed minute values per hour; original observation masks are unavailable.
Voltage and VUF reference lines are study screens, not a compliance assessment.
The stock line sequence-impedance representation has no explicit neutral conductor or neutral-earth voltage model.
